SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (r.return_line_id)) dist_ret, SUM(r.refund_net) refunds
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,r.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,r.store_id) sid, m.ns, r.rs, ROUND(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(r.rs,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND r.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(r.rs,0))>0.05 OR m.store_id IS NULL OR r.store_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT (n.store_id, d.fiscal_week)) sw
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id=n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales this_year, ly.net_sales last_year, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ty.sw, ly.stores, ly.sw
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
